title: Fetched facts about index entries
description: data/meta.json, written only by scripts/fetch_meta.py from the GitHub API. Never hand-edited.

exists.description: false when the repository is gone or private: the site flags the entry.

canonical_repo.description: The repository's current URL, when it was renamed or moved.

latest_tag.description: Newest tag by commit date; null when untagged, in which case the import line pins the default branch.

last_commit.description: Commit date at the head of the default branch.

license.description: SPDX id GitHub detects; 'none' when there is no license file, 'other' when GitHub cannot name it.

upstream_description.description: The project's own GitHub description, kept only so validate.py can check ours is not copied from it.
